sentence_stem: The company's profits fell sharply because
correct_completion: its main factory had to close for three months.
full_sentence: The company's profits fell sharply because its main factory had to close for three months.

options.text: the shareholders were very pleased with the result.
options.why_wrong: This describes a reaction to good results, but profits fell, so it does not explain the drop.

options.text: the board announced a new office in London.
options.why_wrong: This is an unrelated announcement; it does not give a reason for falling profits.

options.text: its main factory had to close for three months.

explanation: After 'because', we need a clause that gives the reason for the fall in profits. Only the closure of the factory explains the drop.
